notes.title: You can leave a review on the store page of the game !
notes.content:
Hi, 
If you played A Way To Die and liked it, you can leave a review on the store page, it takes 10 seconds and helps a lot the game in terms of visibility!

With 10 reviews, Steam gives games a little boost in visibility, 5 more to go and we will reach that goal! It could be awesome.

And of course, thank you a LOT for having played A Way To Die !

notes.title: V1.014
notes.content:
Bug fixes:
-[Major] Portal disappears after leaving the final boss fight room
-[Major] shield bug that makes you invincible against the Brain
-[Major] you can no more buy Items from the parasite or the mutation menu if you bought every item of the category
-[Minor]Translation bug fixed

Balance patch:
-[Item - Elephantasis] reduces the range of the disadvantage
-[Bosses - Brain, Heart, Intestine, Muscle] massive HP up 
-[Character - Covid] power up upgrade
-[Enemi - spawner in the muscle] massive HP up and speed up of the spawned enemies

To be changed:
-[Minor] save not loading correctly resetting the keyboard parameter (azerty or qwerty)
-[Minor] lighting bug when moving at high speed with a big screen
-[Minor] minimap vibrating when moving
-[Major] no-hit achievement too easy to get with shield
-[Major] Controller Support
-[Major] Muscle rework

notes.title: A Way To Die on speedrun.com
notes.content:
Hello everybody, 
[b]A Way To Die[/b] has been accepted on [url=https://www.speedrun.com/a_way_to_die]Speedrun.com[/url] !

There are [b]4 different categories[/b] :
-cold
-influenza
-covid 19
-cancer

Speedrunning the game really adds a [b]lot of fun[/b] so don't hesitate to give it a try, [b]record your run[/b] and be faster than me (I uploaded two of my runs for the covid and influenza categories)!

notes.title: Thank you !
notes.content:
[b]Thank you so much[/b] to everyone who purchased the game and left a [b]review[/b] on the store page! I really appreciate!

[b]For those who haven't left a review yet, it's not too late and that helps me a lot![/b]

We have exceeded 50 units sold, which fully reimburses me the cost of creating the game since it is a personal project and not a job for me

I hope you enjoyed the game as much as I enjoyed creating it.

[b]New content[/b] is coming in June with [b]new playable characters[/b], items and events!
